{{Short description|Chinese researcher}}
'''Dingsheng Wang''' ({{zh|s=王鼎盛|p=Wang Dingsheng}}, born 1940)<ref name="凝聚态理论与计算重点实验室">{{Cite web |title=王鼎盛 |author= |publisher=Key Laboratory of Condensed Matter Theory and Computation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (凝聚态理论与计算重点实验室) |url=http://theory.iphy.ac.cn/222.html |date= |accessdate=2021-06-21 |archivedate=2021-06-21 |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20210621231349/http://theory.iphy.ac.cn/222.html<!--https://web.archive.org/web/20210621231349/http://theory.iphy.ac.cn/222.html  -->}}</ref> is a Chinese [[physicist]], [[nanocatalyst]], and professor at the [[Tsinghua University]]. He is a fellow of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences">{{cite web | title=Division of Mathematics and Physics---Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | website=Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | url=http://english.casad.cas.cn/mem/divsions/domap/ | language=zh | access-date=2023-01-01 | archive-date=2016-11-08 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161108193217/http://english.casad.cas.cn/mem/divsions/domap/ | url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="凝聚态理论与计算重点实验室 2021">{{cite web | title=People-Key Laboratory of Condensed Matter Theory and Computation, Chinese Academy of Sciences | website=Key Laboratory of Condensed Matter Theory and Computation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (凝聚态理论与计算重点实验室) | date=2021-02-20 | url=http://theory.iphy.ac.cn/en/222.html | language=zh | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref><ref name="Nature 2022">{{cite journal | title=Pathways for next-generation nanocatalysts | website=Nature | date=2022-08-10 | url=https://www.nature.com/articles/d42473-022-00287-8 | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref>

His research publication on ''design concept for electrocatalysts'' won the 2022 Nano Research Top Papers Award.<ref name="SciOpen 2022">{{cite web | title=Notice Detail | website=SciOpen | date=2022-12-26 | url=https://www.sciopen.com/journal/message_news/get_by_id?id=1607175246102282242&issn=1998-0124 | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref><ref name="Wang Zheng Wang 2021 pp. 1730–1752">{{cite journal | last1=Wang | first1=Yao | last2=Zheng | first2=Xiaobo | last3=Wang | first3=Dingsheng | title=Design concept for electrocatalysts | journal=Nano Research | publisher=Springer Science and Business Media LLC | volume=15 | issue=3 | date=2021-09-04 | issn=1998-0124 | doi=10.1007/s12274-021-3794-0 | pages=1730–1752| s2cid=237412761 }}</ref>

==Education and career==

Dingsheng obtained a degree in [[physics]] from [[Beijing University]] in 1962. Between 1966 and 1982, he was a research assistant at the [[Institute of Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He became a full professor in 1986.<ref name="凝聚态理论与计算重点实验室 2021"/>
